name: DisplayManager
author: Annerose
description: Manages the game's display: crisp integer/fit/custom scaling in true exclusive fullscreen (native desktop resolution, low-latency direct-flip present), with a tunable sharp-bilinear filter that matches WindowResizer's look (or an experimental xBR pixel-art filter and optional MSAA), plus window sizing (drag or Alt+1..6), spawn position, background color, live filter/sharpness hotkeys with on-screen readout, and persisted settings. Use either this or WindowResizer, never both. See DisplayManager.ini.
